title: Fix TAA pipeline descriptor layout mismatch (VUID 07988)
purpose: Resolve pipeline creation errors by aligning TAA fragment shader descriptors with pipeline layout and disabling unused bindings.

steps.detail: Verify shaders/taa.frag uses only the bindings declared in m_taaDescriptorSetLayout; remove or guard any stale bindings (e.g., binding 3 COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER).
Update TAA descriptor set layout to include exactly the set of bindings used by taa.frag, or compile a variant of the shader with unused paths stripped when RT is enabled.
Rebuild TAA pipeline after layout correction. Add a log printing all bindings (set, binding, type) at pipeline creation.

notes: If using shader variants, ensure correct pipeline is chosen based on render target (HDR vs SDR) and feature toggles.
